sources.content: Spec HV-12: date-based API versions for Hadrovane. Motivation: the Hadrovane API is on URL version `/v3`, and every breaking change forces customers through a large migration. This spec adds a `Hadrovane-Version` request header that takes a date such as `2027-04-01`. Each account is pinned to the version that was current when it made its first API call. Requests may override the pin with the header. The `/v3` path stays and is not replaced by `/v4`.

Limits and rollout. A version is supported for at least 24 months after a newer one is released. Breaking changes ship only in new dated versions, at most four times a year. Unknown dates return HTTP 400 with the error code `invalid_version`. The changelog page lists every version with its changes and a migration note. The first dated version, `2027-04-01`, ships on that day, and a backfill job sets account pins the week before.

claims.text: Hadrovane ships breaking changes at most four times a year.
Under spec HV-12, Hadrovane replaces the /v3 path with /v4.
A Hadrovane account is pinned to the API version that was current at its first API call.
An unknown Hadrovane-Version date returns HTTP 400.
A single request can override the Hadrovane version pin with a header.
A Hadrovane API version is retired 12 months after a newer one is released.
